command: claude --cloud "In this repository, create and switch to a new branch named claude/t5-progress-probe from main. Create the file .wake/progress.md in this exact format: a first line of three dashes, then the lines "phase: <word>", "headline: <one line>", "updated: <current UTC time as RFC 3339>", then a line of three dashes, then a short notes paragraph. Do this five times, about 60 seconds apart (wait with "sleep 60" between rounds). Each round: change phase (plan, build, test, review, done, in that order), change the headline, set updated to the current time, stage only .wake/progress.md, commit it with the message "progress: <phase>", and push the branch to origin. Change nothing else, open no pull request, and do not merge anything. Stop after the fifth push."
